title: Role-aware staff workspace and responsive shell
rootCause: All operational staff roles currently land on /staff/dashboard and the shared staff navigation presents many equal-weight links in one horizontal strip. The shell has shared mobile containment, but the primary operational workspace is not surfaced first for each role.
flow: Login -> routeGuard.getRoleHomeRoute -> frontendRoleAccess.getDefaultPathForRole -> AppRouter /staff entry -> StaffLayout -> role-filtered navigation -> /staff/orders or /staff/kitchen workspace
acceptanceCriteria: Server, host, cashier and supervisor roles land on /staff/orders.
Chef, cook, kitchen_helper and bartender roles land on /staff/kitchen.
Direct /staff entry uses the same role-aware landing rule.
Visible navigation keeps the role's primary workspace first without changing role or permission guards.
Desktop navigation is grouped and wraps without horizontal page overflow.
Mobile navigation remains keyboard/touch accessible, closes after route changes, and does not cover staff content.
No GraphQL contract, backend guard, restaurant scope or operational data flow changes.

planned: manual review at 390x844 and 430x932 when a browser is available
